event.content:
Celebration nights in New York City: which nights bring injuries, and will they come again

Every count is said with whose count it is. "Taken into custody", "arrested" and "charged" are three different numbers. Our own counts are EMS dispatches and complaints, not people hurt: one dispatch may be no one, or several people. Typical is the same weekday's night over the eight weeks before (EMS), or the January–April 2026 median (complaints and arrests).

Thu 1 May 2025: First-round clinch, away (Detroit)
- 16 EMS incidents dispatched with an injury call type (typical 8): our count from FDNY's EMS dispatch records. https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/76xm-jjuj

Fri 16 May 2025: Second-round clinch, at the Garden
- 19 EMS incidents dispatched with an injury call type (typical 11): our count from FDNY's EMS dispatch records. https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/76xm-jjuj

Thu 21 May 2026: Conference finals Game 2, at the Garden
- 6 people arrested: the NYPD, as CBS News New York reported it. https://www.cbsnews.com/newyork/news/knicks-outdoor-watch-parties-nypd/

Mon 25 May 2026: Conference finals clinch, away (Cleveland)
- 9 EMS incidents dispatched with an injury call type (typical 10): our count from FDNY's EMS dispatch records. https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/76xm-jjuj

Wed 3 Jun 2026: Finals Game 1, away (San Antonio)
- 7 people taken into custody: the NYPD, as Gothamist reported it. https://gothamist.com/news/fans-are-jubilant-and-mostly-orderly-after-knicks-prevail-in-nba-finals-opener
- 5 of them given summonses: the NYPD, as Gothamist reported it. https://gothamist.com/news/fans-are-jubilant-and-mostly-orderly-after-knicks-prevail-in-nba-finals-opener
- 2 of them with charges pending: the NYPD, as Gothamist reported it. https://gothamist.com/news/fans-are-jubilant-and-mostly-orderly-after-knicks-prevail-in-nba-finals-opener
- 8 EMS incidents dispatched with an injury call type (typical 11): our count from FDNY's EMS dispatch records. https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/76xm-jjuj

Fri 5 Jun 2026: Finals Game 2, away (San Antonio)
- 19 EMS incidents dispatched with an injury call type (typical 12): our count from FDNY's EMS dispatch records. https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/76xm-jjuj
- 75 arrests in precincts 14 and 18 that day (typical 40): our count from the NYPD's arrest data. https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/uip8-fykc

Mon 8 Jun 2026: Finals Game 3, at the Garden (a loss)
- 21 people taken into custody: the NYPD, as CBS News New York reported it. https://www.cbsnews.com/newyork/news/knicks-game-3-nba-finals-watch-party-bryant-park-arrests-nypd/
- 8 of them charged: the NYPD, as CBS News New York reported it. https://www.cbsnews.com/newyork/news/knicks-game-3-nba-finals-watch-party-bryant-park-arrests-nypd/
- 13 of them given summonses: the NYPD, as CBS News New York reported it. https://www.cbsnews.com/newyork/news/knicks-game-3-nba-finals-watch-party-bryant-park-arrests-nypd/
- 5 officers injured: the NYPD, as Gothamist reported it. https://gothamist.com/news/knicks-fans-swarm-midtown-after-teams-first-loss-of-nba-finals
- 15 EMS incidents dispatched with an injury call type (typical 9): our count from FDNY's EMS dispatch records. https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/76xm-jjuj

Wed 10 Jun 2026: Finals Game 4, at the Garden
- 56 people taken into custody: the NYPD, as CBS News New York reported it. https://www.cbsnews.com/newyork/news/knicks-game-4-crowd-arrests-near-madison-square-garden/
- 15 of them arrested: the NYPD, as CBS News New York reported it. https://www.cbsnews.com/newyork/news/knicks-game-4-crowd-arrests-near-madison-square-garden/
- 41 of them given summonses: the NYPD, as CBS News New York reported it. https://www.cbsnews.com/newyork/news/knicks-game-4-crowd-arrests-near-madison-square-garden/
- 10 officers injured: the NYPD, as Gothamist reported it. https://gothamist.com/news/nypd-arrests-56-as-crowds-of-unruly-fans-storm-midtown-after-knicks-win
- 4 NYPD vehicles damaged: the NYPD, as Gothamist reported it. https://gothamist.com/news/nypd-arrests-56-as-crowds-of-unruly-fans-storm-midtown-after-knicks-win
- 27 EMS incidents dispatched with an injury call type (typical 11): our count from FDNY's EMS dispatch records. https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/76xm-jjuj
- 21 assault, criminal mischief and arson complaints in precincts 14 and 18, begun that day (typical 10): our count from the NYPD's complaint data. https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/5uac-w243

Sat 13 Jun 2026: Finals Game 5, away (San Antonio): the title
- 63 people taken into custody: the NYPD, as CBS News New York reported it. https://www.cbsnews.com/newyork/news/knicks-celebration-violence-arrests-nypd/
- 15 of them criminally charged: the NYPD, as Gothamist reported it. https://gothamist.com/news/nyc-knicks-celebrations-marred-by-7-shootings-police-say
- 10 officers injured: the NYPD, as CBS News New York reported it. https://www.cbsnews.com/newyork/news/knicks-celebration-violence-arrests-nypd/
- 4 stabbings or slashings: the NYPD, as Gothamist reported it. https://gothamist.com/news/knicks-in-five-new-yorkers-celebrate-the-championship-with-all-night-party
- 5 school buses set on fire or wrecked: the NYPD, as CBS News New York reported it. https://www.cbsnews.com/newyork/news/times-square-knicks-celebration-bus-lit-on-fire/
- 5 NYPD vehicles damaged: the NYPD, as Gothamist reported it. https://gothamist.com/news/knicks-in-five-new-yorkers-celebrate-the-championship-with-all-night-party
- 7 shootings connected to the celebrations citywide over the weekend, in the Police Commissioner's words: the NYPD, as Gothamist reported it. https://gothamist.com/news/nyc-knicks-celebrations-marred-by-7-shootings-police-say
- 44 EMS incidents dispatched with an injury call type (typical 11): our count from FDNY's EMS dispatch records. https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/76xm-jjuj
- 35 assault, criminal mischief and arson complaints in precincts 14 and 18, begun on 13 June (typical 10): our count from the NYPD's complaint data. https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/5uac-w243
- 40 the same complaints, begun on 14 June (typical 10): our count from the NYPD's complaint data. https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/5uac-w243
- 9 shooting incidents citywide on 14 June (typical 2): our count from the NYPD's shooting data. https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/5ucz-vwe8

Thu 18 Jun 2026: The victory parade, Lower Manhattan
- 13 arrests (Gothamist, evening): the NYPD, as Gothamist reported it. https://gothamist.com/news/close-to-2-million-fans-descended-on-lower-manhattan-for-the-knicks-parade-nypd-said-most-were-peaceful
- 11 people taken into custody, 10 of them arrested (FOX 5 New York, earlier in the day): the NYPD, as FOX 5 New York reported it. https://www.fox5ny.com/sports/knicks-parade-numbers-2-million-celebrate-nba-title-dozens-hospitalized
- 30 people taken to hospitals by 4:13 pm: FDNY, as Gothamist reported it. https://gothamist.com/news/close-to-2-million-fans-descended-on-lower-manhattan-for-the-knicks-parade-nypd-said-most-were-peaceful
- 31 people treated on scene: FDNY, as Gothamist reported it. https://gothamist.com/news/close-to-2-million-fans-descended-on-lower-manhattan-for-the-knicks-parade-nypd-said-most-were-peaceful
- 15 EMS incidents dispatched with an injury call type, the night after the parade (typical 8): our count from FDNY's EMS dispatch records. https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/76xm-jjuj

Decisions that shaped the nights:
- 23 May 2026: The NYPD said it would no longer support watch parties outside the Garden. Whose decision: the NYPD. https://www.cbsnews.com/newyork/news/knicks-outdoor-watch-parties-nypd/
- 3 Jun 2026: By Game 1, the city had approved watch parties in Central Park and outside the Garden. Whose decision: the City of New York. https://gothamist.com/news/fans-are-jubilant-and-mostly-orderly-after-knicks-prevail-in-nba-finals-opener
- 8 Jun 2026: No watch party outside the Garden, because of security for a presidential visit. Whose decision: not named in the reports read. https://www.cbsnews.com/newyork/news/knicks-game-3-nba-finals-watch-party-bryant-park-arrests-nypd/
- 10 Jun 2026: The official watch party was cancelled that afternoon. Whose decision: not named in the reports read. https://www.cbsnews.com/newyork/news/knicks-game-4-crowd-arrests-near-madison-square-garden/

Settled answers:
- Q1. Which Knicks playoff nights in 2025 and 2026 were followed by more than 1.5 times the usual injury-class EMS dispatches in NYPD precincts 14 and 18, by FDNY's dispatch records? Three nights: 1 May 2025, 10 June 2026 and 13 June 2026, by the rule (at least 1.5 times the usual and a Poisson tail below 1%), from FDNY's dispatch records.
- Q2. How many members of the NYPD were injured on 8, 10 and 13–14 June 2026, by the NYPD's count? 5 on 8 June, 10 on 10 June and 10 on 13–14 June, by the NYPD's count as CBS News New York and Gothamist reported it.
- Q3. How many people did the NYPD take into custody on 13–14 June 2026, and how many of them were criminally charged? 63 taken into custody, 15 of them criminally charged, by the NYPD's count as CBS News New York and Gothamist reported it.
- Q9. Were assault, criminal mischief and arson complaints in precincts 14 and 18 higher on 13–14 June 2026 than usual, by the NYPD's complaint data? Yes: 35 begun on 13 June and 40 on 14 June, against a typical 10 (the January–April 2026 median), from the NYPD's complaint data.

How likely a repeat is, if the night happens: On past clinch and title nights, Midtown saw a sharp rise in injury calls 2 of 6 times. On an ordinary night that happens about 3 times in 100. The rule was written after these nights were seen, so this shows the method; the next season tests it.

No civilian injury total for these nights was published by the NYPD or FDNY in the sources read. No one in these records is named or described here, and nothing is placed finer than a precinct.
